title: Offsider (com.mpalmes.offsider)
description: Ceilings an administrator sets for Offsider on a managed Mac. Offsider honours a key only while macOS reports it forced; a key left out sets no limit, and a key of the wrong type refuses every physical device.

allowPhysicalDevices.title: Allow physical devices
allowPhysicalDevices.description: False refuses every phone, iPhone and iPad. True sets no limit beyond each person's allow-list.

allowedDeviceIDs.title: Allowed device IDs
allowedDeviceIDs.description: Only these devices may be driven: iPhone and iPad UDIDs (any case) and Android serials (exact). An empty list allows none.

allowedBundleIDs.title: Allowed app IDs
allowedBundleIDs.description: Apps on a physical device are limited to these exact bundle ids and package names. An empty list allows none.

deniedBundleIDs.title: Denied app IDs
deniedBundleIDs.description: Apps Offsider never signs in to on any device, and never drives on a physical device. An entry ending in a full stop is a prefix.

allowTestDevices.title: Allow test devices
allowTestDevices.description: While any key is set, a test device is a plain Any app allowance unless this is true and neither app list nor requirePinnedApps is set.

forceMasks.title: Keep masks and redaction on
forceMasks.description: True refuses every way to drop a password mask or log redaction, for a person and an agent alike.

maxAllowanceDays.title: Longest allowance, in days
maxAllowanceDays.description: The longest a physical device's allowance lasts. Longer and endless allowances are refused, and a saved one ends this many days after it was added.

allowSavedLogins.title: Allow saved logins
allowSavedLogins.description: False refuses login, and credential add, describe and join, on every device.

allowFileInput.title: Allow --allow-path
allowFileInput.description: False refuses --allow-path on type --file and batch for a file Offsider protects, such as one under ~/.ssh or named .env.

allowMetroReverse.title: Allow adb reverse to Metro
allowMetroReverse.description: False stops rn open setting an adb reverse on a phone, or using one it set.

allowRunnerRegistration.title: Allow runner registration
allowRunnerRegistration.description: False refuses runner build --register-device and builds the iPhone runner without -allowProvisioningUpdates, so Xcode creates no App ID, profile or device record.

allowedTeamIDs.title: Allowed Apple team IDs
allowedTeamIDs.description: Only these Apple development teams (any case) may sign the iPhone runner. An empty list allows none.

requirePinnedApps.title: Require named apps
requirePinnedApps.description: True limits each physical device to named apps: no Any app allowance and no test device.

allowUnlockCodes.title: Allow saved unlock codes
allowUnlockCodes.description: False refuses unlock-code set and wake --unlock.

allowPhonePermissionChanges.title: Allow permission changes on phones
allowPhonePermissionChanges.description: False refuses permission grant, revoke and reset on a phone, iPhone or iPad.
